raw_text:
Warehouse Operations Risk Report
Reporting Period: September 2026
The warehouse is experiencing operational issues affecting order processing and dispatch.
Observed Risks
1. Delivery risk: outbound shipments may be delayed because loading capacity is limited during
peak hours.
2. Inventory risk: stock records for several products do not match the physical count.
3. Safety risk: two forklifts require inspection before the next operating shift.
4. Supplier dependency: packaging material from the primary supplier is running low.
Current Actions
Operations supervisor will arrange forklift inspection. Inventory team will perform a physical recount.
Procurement will contact an alternate supplier.
